how_to_steps: Download Claude Desktop, open the Code tab, paste the GitHub setup link and ask Claude Code to set it up
Sign up at arcads.ai, Settings > Public API, copy the secret and give it to Claude Code
In Claude Desktop Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector, paste the Meta Ads MCP URL (https://mcp.facebook.com/ads) and connect your Meta ads account
Hand Claude the URL of an Airtable database of example ads (2,000+)
Prompt: 'Here is a database full of ads. Pick 50 you think will work best for my offer. Ask me 20 questions to make sure we get this right.' Answer the questions
Receive ~50 ads; tell Claude Code to upload them to the ad account, giving it the ad ID of one manually built ad to clone all settings and swap only the creative

relevance.why: Haji sells apps and needs paid acquisition without an agency; this is a concrete, reproducible pipeline (Meta's own MCP + a swipe-file database + a clone-by-ad-ID safety trick) rather than hype. Creator is selling a community, so claims are promotional.

implement_score.why: Doable in an afternoon: add the Meta Ads MCP connector, build a small Airtable/CSV of winning ads in the niche, use the 20-questions prompt, generate with Arcads or any image model, and upload by cloning a reference ad ID. The hard part is a quality ad library and ad spend budget; start with 5-10 ads not 50.

verify: Confirm Meta's Ads MCP server (mcp.facebook.com/ads) is GA and what permissions it needs; the docs page date 'Jul 14, 2026' suggests recent
Arcads pricing per image and whether static image ads are its strength (it markets AI actors/video)
The $30K claim is unverified; shown rows are spend, not revenue
The GitHub setup repo is never named; find it or write the orchestration prompt yourself

gap.what: Liked set has a reaction video about Claude running Meta ads; this is the actual recipe: Meta's hosted Ads MCP, Arcads API, an Airtable swipe-file of 2,000 ads, the 'ask me 20 questions' step, and cloning a known-good ad ID so uploads inherit correct settings.
